user.description: Export entity data or YAML files from HA Landscape in the sidebar. Upload the export in a separate AI chat, then download the result and import it into Landscape to review and apply changes. An additional CSV inventory is available through the integration's entities. Exported CSV files are public at `/local/ha_entitaeten.csv` until you delete them.

delete_csv.description: Deletes the public entity inventory file.
delete_csv.name: Delete CSV file

export_csv.description: Creates a complete CSV inventory of all Home Assistant entities.
export_csv.name: Create CSV export
